description: iOpenPod - iTunes alternative for classic iPods: library sync with FLAC to ALAC auto-conversion, iTunesDB metadata editing and podcast syncing
notes: ffmpeg (transcoding, ffprobe) and fpcalc (Chromaprint audio fingerprints) come from the main/ffmpeg-shared and main/chromaprint dependencies; iOpenPod finds them on PATH (ffmpeg-shared adds its bin folder, chromaprint shims fpcalc). Leave the tool paths in its settings empty and decline its offer to download its own copies.

iOpenPod checks GitHub for a new release on every start and offers 'Download and Install', which overwrites the files in the scoop version folder behind scoop's back. Decline it and run 'scoop update iopenpod' instead.
Settings live in %APPDATA%\iOpenPod, logs, backups and cache in ~\iOpenPod - both outside the app folder, so they survive updates without persist and are NOT removed on uninstall.
